title: Kanebo Suisai Beauty Clear Powder Wash 32pcs
description_en: Kanebo's powder facial wash contains two types of enzymes that break down pores, excess sebum, and dead skin. One capsule per use, hygienic and travel-friendly. Japan's most popular pore-care cleanser.
description_ja: 2種の酵素が毛穴の角栓・黒ずみを分解するカネボウ「すはだ酵素洗顔パウダー」。1包ずつ個包装で衛生的。日本で最も人気の毛穴ケア洗顔料。
